finding: selected endpoint-role repair causally improves two frozen full-stack metrics with no frozen metric harm
method_lesson: when an upstream repair is shown to improve a frozen downstream stack, reuse the already-frozen end-to-end challenge and change only the causally selected upstream artifact; do not redesign the benchmark after seeing the result
execution_lesson: historical same-revision freeze receipts may need a derived execution binding when plumbing changes but evaluator/challenge/spec/weights remain byte-identical; bind both the old immutable hashes and the new authorization rather than mutating the old receipt
